2607.07601.title: CARLA-GS: Decoupling Representation, Reasoning, and Physics Simulation for Autonomous Driving Corner-Case Synthesis
2607.07601.paper_summary: Safety evaluation for autonomous driving is dominated by rare, safety-critical interactions, motivating simulators that can deliberately synthesize corner cases with photorealistic observations. Corner-case generation is inherently a multi-source problem spanning visual representation, scene reasoning, and vehicle trajectory generation and control. Prior knowledge- and model-based approaches typically focus on scene or trajectory components in isolation, while diffusion-based methods attempt end-to-end generation but still struggle to ensure spatiotemporal consistency and physical realism. To unify these aspects within a single framework, we propose CARLA-GS, a modular corner-case synthesis pipeline that decouples visual representation, semantic reasoning, and physics-based execution while maintaining tight cross-module coupling. Starting from real driving data, we reconstruct an editable gaussian scene with additional geometry-consistent constraints. A multi-agent LLM then performs scene-level reasoning to identify risky interactions and generate intent-level waypoint trajectories, while the low-level motion control is delegated to CARLA, where a PID controller ensures kinematic and dynamic feasibility. The simulated vehicle states are finally re-projected into the gaussian scene for ego-centric rendering. This design enables high-level semantic reasoning, low-level physically executable motion, and photorealistic corner-case generation within a unified pipeline. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show, both quantitatively and qualitatively, that our framework enables controllable corner-case generation and produces photorealistic, spatiotemporally consistent videos aligned with semantic intent and physically feasible motion.
2607.07601.paper_summary_zh: 安全評估自動駕駛主要受稀有且關鍵的安全互動影響，這促使了能夠故意合成邊緣案例並提供照片真實觀察的模擬器。邊緣案例生成本質上是一個多來源問題，涵蓋視覺表現、場景推理以及車輛軌跡生成與控制。先前的知識和模型基礎方法通常專注於場景或軌跡組件的孤立分析，而基於擴散的方法則嘗試進行端到端的生成，但仍然難以確保時空一致性和物理真實性。為了在單一框架內統一這些方面，我們提出了CARLA-GS，一個模組化的邊緣案例合成管道，該管道解耦了視覺表現、語義推理和基於物理的執行，同時保持緊密的跨模組耦合。從真實駕駛數據開始，我們重建了一個可編輯的高斯場景，並添加了幾何一致性約束。一個多代理LLM然後執行場景級推理，以識別風險互動並生成意圖級的路徑點軌跡，而低級運動控制則委派給CARLA，在那裡PID控制器確保運動學和動力學的可行性。模擬的車輛狀態最終重新投影到高斯場景中以進行自我中心的渲染。這種設計使得高級語義推理、低級物理可執行運動和照片真實的邊緣案例生成能夠在統一的管道中實現。在Waymo Open Dataset上的實驗顯示，我們的框架無論在量化還是質化上，都能實現可控的邊緣案例生成，並生成與語義意圖和物理可行運動一致的照片真實、時空一致的視頻。
